'''Estus''' is the magic substance at the center of [[enchanting]] in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. It is dropped by undead [[mobs]] and passes through several forms: [[Raw Estus]] heals the player when picked up and turns into [[Estus Ash]], which is crafted into [[Stabilized Estus]] or [[Crystallized Estus]]. The name is a reference to the healing estus of the ''Dark Souls'' series.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=In addition, all undead mobs drop raw Estus or Estus Ash, an ode to a brilliant game, of course. If collected, raw Estus heals the player and turns into Estus Ash, a powerful magic component which we'll get back to later.}}</ref>

The estus items replace the {{MCW|Blaze|blaze}}-related items and glowstone of vanilla ''Minecraft''.

== Mechanics ==
=== Healing ===
{{Main|Raw Estus#Behavior}}
When a player who is not in Creative mode gets Raw Estus in their inventory, each piece is used up at once: it grants a burst of Regeneration V and Resistance I, and is replaced with one Estus Ash.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/estus/estus_effects.mcfunction}}</ref> Killing zombies is therefore a way to heal in a fight, since the pack has no [[natural regeneration]].

=== Magic ===
Estus Ash is the most common magic ingredient. Seven of them, a [[Benzene]] and a [[Stable Void]] make one Stabilized Estus, which is the core of every Hell-Bound Book and of the eye of ender.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Estus Ash, an ender pearl, and Benzene together can make stabilized Estus. This is a vital crafting component for most magic. Hellbound books use them, the warning stone has stabilized Estus at its center, and the Eye of Ender is crafted from this material.}}</ref>

Blazes, which are not undead, do not drop any estus; they drop {{MCW|Fire Charge|fire charges}} instead.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/blaze.json}}</ref>
